item.title: Investigating a Curious Case of Font Format Fallbacks
item.description: Every month the NY WebPerf Meetup runs a session called Meet4Speed, where Sergey Chernyshev and I meet with members of the local developer community and talk about web performance. It’s an incredibly fun and interactive meetup. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Workshop: How to Implement Session Replay
item.description: Session Replay isn't just the video attached to your error. Join us for a hands-on look at custom React hooks, User Feedback with replays attached, and the filters and tags that help you find the sessions you're looking for. (1 source: frontendfocus)
